import csv, sys
from datetime import datetime
sys.path.insert(0, ".")
from attendance import load, as_utc
latest = {}
for r in load():
    k = (r["badge"], r["session"])
    t = datetime.fromisoformat(r["observed_at"])
    if k not in latest or t > latest[k][0]:
        latest[k] = (t, r)
out = [(k[0], k[1], as_utc(r["started_at"])) for k, (t, r) in sorted(latest.items()) if r["status"] != "cancelled"]
with open("build/normalized.csv", "w", newline="") as f:
    w = csv.writer(f, lineterminator="\n")
    w.writerow(["badge", "session", "start_utc"]); w.writerows(out)
EOF
